caption: P1 sends m1 at scalar time 2; P2 receives it and jumps to 3 before sending m2 at 4; P3 receives m2 and jumps to 5. The internal events in the worked example are P1 a = 1, P2 c = 1, and P3 f = 1, g = 2.
